theorems.name: Submission.varifold_weight_integral_tendsto_of_radonConverges
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, g x ∂(Vi i).weight) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂V.weight))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
